raw_attributes.value: FRAM Drive™cabin air filters prevent harmful airborne particles from entering your vehicle’s cabin. It is engineered to filter the air before it gets to you, removing dust, pollen, and other pollutants. Replacing a dirty cabin air filter with a new FRAM Drive cabin air filter can optimize clean air flow and maintain peak HVAC system performance. FRAM recommends changing your cabin air filter every 12 months.
Optimizes airflow and maintains HVAC performance
Removes dust, pollen, and other pollutants
Up to 12 months or 12,000 mile (19,000 kilometer) protection
Available to Order -	Part is released to customers for ordering.
